dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: As you can see, this is a bit of a dingy tavern. I'm the helmsman here, but you can call me Boss. Whatever you want.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: You just tell me what you want to drink. I'll do my best to either make it myself, or find it for you.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Of course, if you really want me to help find some new goods which aren't on the shelves, then you'll have to pay a little more.
